## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 5-fascicle text by [鮮演](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%AE%AE%E6%BC%94) Xiānyǎn (1049–1118), the senior Liáo-dynasty Buddhist scholar, is a substantial study of the *xuán tán* 玄談 ("profound discourses" — i.e. the doctrinal-preliminary essays) sections of [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) Chéngguān's *[Huáyán jīng shū](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0011)* (T1735). The work is one of the principal documents of Liáo-period (Khitan) Buddhist scholarship and one of the few extant Liáo Buddhist commentaries on a Tang Huáyán-school work.

**Abstract**

The work is conventionally datable to [鮮演](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%AE%AE%E6%BC%94) Xiānyǎn's mature period, c. 1080 – 1118 CE; the bracket adopted here reflects this window. The Liáo Buddhist establishment was strongly committed to the Tang Huáyán doctrinal heritage; Xiānyǎn's work documents the school's continuing northern-Chinese transmission under Khitan rule, in parallel with but separate from the Northern-Sòng Huìyīnsì Huáyán-revival project of [淨源](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%B7%A8%E6%BA%90) Jìngyuán.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X235) collection.
